assertions.assertion: Uses IApiScopeAdmin.CreateAsync with ApiScopeConfiguration before creating the resource/client that references it
Uses IApiResourceAdmin and IClientAdmin.CreateAsync with CreateClient and CreateClientSecret { PlaintextValue = ... }
assertions.rationale: Uses EF entities and Secret Sha256, not IApiResourceAdmin/IClientAdmin or CreateClientSecret.
No SaveResult.IsSuccess or GetResult.Found; only SaveChangesAsync.

assertions.assertion: Updates via GetAsync then UpdateAsync(id, item, current.Version, ct) to get optimistic concurrency
assertions.rationale: Does not use GetAsync/UpdateAsync with Version; only suggests custom row-version.

assertions.assertion: Warns to protect/authorize the admin APIs (they are .NET service APIs, not preconfigured HTTP endpoints) and to load secrets from a secure source
assertions.rationale: No warning about protecting admin APIs or secure secret source; hardcodes "s3cret".
